newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate softens at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate softens at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate eased further at midday on Wednesday, and dealers said loose liquidity in the banking system may force the rate to drift lower later in the session.
The overnight interbank rate was at 5.152 percent against Tuesday's 5.162 close, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 5.15-5.20.
The rate is seen to hover around 5.10-5.20 this week.
In the bond market, the seven-year 86/3 bond yield was at 5.94 percent against 5.96. Dealers said overall sentiment in the bond market remain slugglish. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
